title: BMW OBD-II Trouble Codes
content:
BMW OBD-II Trouble Codes
Note: See this page for generic OBD-II codes (they start with P0***).

- 2017 BMW 430i with DME FC 21A02D code

- Bmw e46 2002 model 318i n42 motor
Car kranks but doesn't wabt to start and im not picking up any errors in the scan...
- e92 320i error code P1062 and P1050
my 2007 e92 320i has gone into limp mode and I scanned it with the codes P1062 and P1050 showing up. i have a half engine light and a full engine light, I can also hear a slight rattle from the engine time to time. if anyone has any help or advice on...
- 2017 BMW i3
Have engine light on, trying to make sense of the OBD codes, mine don't seem to be relevant for an EV. Can't even find a listing for the B0B (body?) codes P0101 .. air flow P0043 .. heater ctrl circuit .. P0047 unknown P004A .. turbo c...
- '05 BMW X5 4.4 Misfire on all cylinders
One minute it runs fine and then it starts misfiring and I get the notice Engine Failsafe program and then it goes away. The codes are P0300, 301, thru 307. I also get some I've never seen before. 2A5A, 2A5C, 2A6C, 2E95, 2A6B, 2D13, 2000, 2013, 2A69...
